outcome: Rate of cesarean delivery (CD) due to non-reassuring fetal heart rate (NRFHR)
cohort: The study included 894 women with gestational diabetes mellitus (types A1 and A2) admitted to a fetal-maternal unit between 2014 and 2023.
finding: Among GDMA2 patients, metformin treatment was independently associated with small-for-gestational-age (SGA) neonates.
mod_finding: The SGA group had a significantly higher rate of cesarean delivery due to non-reassuring fetal heart rate compared to the AGA group.
birth_weight: SGA infants: 2375 ± 432 g; AGA infants: 3021 ± 165 g
